name: proto-default-roots-own-files-of-one-path-in-two-trees
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: two directory trees that each hold their own schema file at one path, as services built one at a time with their own include path do, import it by its path from their tree, which resolves under no root, so each importer publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note, and neither reads the other tree's file. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
